data_role: DEVELOPMENT DIAGNOSTIC (minimal-pair probe v2). Never V5 training, validation or checkpoint-selection data; never copied into a V5 generator.

pre_registered.multiplicity: Holm within the CONTENT family; control outside (raw p)
pre_registered.direction: A->B hypothesised; B->A labelled as reverse and non-supporting
pre_registered.no_observed_effect: 0 discordant pairs AND A->B testable (reference-ALLOW >= ceil(2n/3)); otherwise NO OBSERVED (UNTESTABLE), which cannot falsify

stratum_rule.heterogeneous: at least one 'effect' stratum and one 'no effect (testable)' stratum

instability.rule: material iff CP lower bound >= 0.05; C_hi = CONTROL-COV2 flip-rate CP95 upper bound used as the effect bar
